payout_quote: Fetch's official eReceipts guide: link a supported email/Amazon account, tap the camera icon, choose eReceipt, select eligible receipts (from supported retailers, less than 14 days old), and submit — the official example shows three online orders a week earning at least 75 points (about 25 base points per eligible eReceipt). Points redeem through the Fetch Rewards catalog (3,000 points = $3 gift cards, verified in R0119).
timing: Points credit after submitted eReceipts are processed; redeem via the Fetch Rewards catalog once you reach the catalog minimum (3,000 points = $3, per R0119).
biggest_catch: eReceipts earn only about 25 base points each (~$0.025 at the Fetch catalog rate), so this is a slow trickle of variable micro-earnings — never guaranteed income; only receipts from supported retailers less than 14 days old qualify, and catalog redemptions start at 3,000 points ($3).
eligibility: Fetch account; eReceipts from supported retailers; receipts must be less than 14 days old (official guide).
steps: In the Fetch app, link your supported email or Amazon account in the eReceipts section.
Tap the camera icon and choose 'eReceipt'.
Select your eligible receipts (supported retailers, less than 14 days old) and submit them.
Earn base points per eReceipt (official example: three online orders a week earn at least 75 points).
Redeem accumulated Fetch points through the Rewards catalog — 3,000 points = $3 gift cards (verified route R0119).
catches: About 25 base points per eligible eReceipt (~$0.025 at the Fetch catalog rate).
Only supported retailers and receipts under 14 days old qualify (official guide).
Catalog redemptions start at 3,000 points ($3 gift cards, verified in R0119).
This route is a sub-program of the Fetch program already verified in R0119 — same points balance and catalog.
notes: Official fetch.com eReceipts guide read 2026-09-23: submission steps, retailer/14-day eligibility, 75-points-per-3-orders example. Redemption value via the already-verified Fetch catalog (R0119: 3,000 points = $3 gift cards). R0155 is a sub-program of the same Fetch program verified in R0119.
